evals.prompt: I just wrote a bookmarks module for the server — it's at server/src/modules/bookmarks/. Before I register it in modules/index.ts, review it and tell me what's structurally wrong with it and how to fix it.
evals.expected_output: Flags: (1) routes.ts imports drizzle-orm + db/schema and queries container.db in GET /bookmarks; (2) service.ts imports FastifyRequest and takes the raw request in create(); (3) repository.ts holds business rules (MAX_BOOKMARKS_PER_WORKSPACE cap and duplicate check throwing ConflictError).
assertions: B1: Flags routes.ts importing drizzle-orm / db/schema.js and querying container.db directly in the GET /bookmarks handler
B1-sev: Rates the route→DB issue (B1) as CRITICAL
B2: Flags service.ts importing FastifyRequest / taking the raw request (req.body, getContext(req)) in create()
B2-sev: Rates the service→Fastify issue (B2) as CRITICAL
B3: Flags repository.ts holding business rules (the 200-bookmark cap and/or the duplicate-bookmark ConflictError) that belong in the service
B-fix: Proposes moving the list query into service + repository methods (e.g. service.list → repo.list)

evals.prompt: Here's a new digests module at server/src/modules/digests/. It works locally but my teammate says it'll be painful to test and maintain. Review it and list the issues.
evals.expected_output: Flags: (1) service.ts constructs new OctokitGitHubClient(token) inline instead of container.github(); (2) service.ts imports another module's repository file (../reviews/repository/review.repo.js) directly instead of container.reviewRepo; (3) a raw Drizzle DigestRow is returned through the service/route to the HTTP client without mapping to a @devdigest/shared DTO.
assertions: D1: Flags the inline `new OctokitGitHubClient(token)` in service.ts and says to use container.github() instead
D2: Flags service.ts importing another module's repository file (reviews/repository/review.repo.js) directly
D2-fix: Recommends going through the shared container repository (container.reviewRepo) for the cross-module read
D3: Flags that a raw Drizzle DigestRow is returned to the HTTP client without mapping to a DTO
D3-fix: Recommends a row→DTO mapper (e.g. toDigestDto in helpers.ts) and/or a @devdigest/shared contract for the response

evals.prompt: Review server/src/modules/notifications/ — does the code put things in the right places? List every problem you find.
evals.expected_output: Flags: (1) repository.ts imports @devdigest/shared DTOs and maps rows to them; (2) service.ts imports drizzle-orm + db/schema and calls container.db.update in markRead, bypassing the repository; (3) repository.ts mixes two aggregates (notifications and notification_preferences) in one file.
assertions: N1: Flags repository.ts importing @devdigest/shared DTO types and mapping rows to DTOs inside the repository
N1-fix: Recommends moving the row→DTO mapping into helpers.ts / the service
N2: Flags service.ts markRead calling container.db.update(...) directly / importing drizzle-orm + db/schema, bypassing the repository
N3: Flags repository.ts mixing two aggregates (notifications and notification preferences) and suggests splitting into per-entity repo files
